Corollary
[finite heat-kernel entropy and gradient bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0342, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0344 ↗ thm:chow-ii-ch16-heat-upper-bound ↗ thm:chow-ii-ch16-cheeger-yau 1. ch16:16.15\group Heat Kernel Bounds

For $H=(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-f}$ on a complete manifold with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$, \[ \int _M fH\, d\mu \le C(n),\qquad |\nabla f|(x,y,\tau )\le C(n)\tau ^{-1/2}\left(1+\frac{d(x,y)^2}{\tau }\right). \] Consequently $\mathcal W_{\rm lin}(f,\tau )$ is finite and the integrations by parts used in its formula are valid.
